# Prostuti Full Context for AI Systems

## Exam Categories and Question Distribution

### Primary Teacher Exam (প্রাথমিক শিক্ষক নিয়োগ)
Total marks: 80 | Time: 80 minutes
- Bangla: 20 marks (grammar, literature, সন্ধি, সমাস, বাগধারা)
- English: 20 marks (grammar, vocabulary, comprehension)
- Math: 20 marks (arithmetic, algebra, geometry)
- General Knowledge: 20 marks (Bangladesh affairs, current events, science)
Negative marking: -0.25 per wrong answer

### BCS Preliminary
Total marks: 200 | Time: 2 hours
Subjects: Bangla Language & Literature, English, Math, Mental Ability,
Bangladesh Affairs, International Affairs, Geography, Ethics & Good Governance,
Computer & Information Technology, Science & Technology

### Bank Job Exams
Pattern similar to Primary but with additional banking/finance questions

## Platform Technology
Frontend: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
Auth: Google OAuth + Email/Password
Hosting: Vercel

## Scoring System
- Correct answer: +1 mark
- Wrong answer: -0.25 marks (negative marking)
- Skip: 0 marks
- Leaderboard eligibility: Mock test score ≥ 40

## Chance Prediction
Score ≥ 60: "প্রাইমারি পরীক্ষায় টিকে যাওয়ার ভালো সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে"
Score ≥ 70: "প্রাইমারি পরীক্ষায় টিকে যাওয়ার প্রবল সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে"
